description: Scores a restaurant's 12 answers against RestaurantDoctorAI's targets for its type of restaurant and returns the free result the website shows: an overall grade, grades by area, the biggest leak or opportunity with its estimated money a month, the estimated yearly profit leak and the first fix. Includes a link that opens the same result on restaurantdoctorai.com. The result also notes the paid full report on the website, its price and what it adds. Takes only the 12 answers and the country; restaurantdoctor_get_questions gives the wording of each answer value. The answers aren't stored; only an anonymous daily count of checks is kept.

beverageMonitoring.description: How do you control drink pours? no_alcohol = We don't serve alcohol; measured_pour_keg_audits = Measured pours, plus weekly pour-cost checks; occasional_spot_checks = Spot checks when bottles run out early; free_pour_no_audit = Free pours, no pour-cost checks.

contactCapture.description: How do you bring guests back? automated_pos_loyalty_50plus = Loyalty or email list with automatic campaigns (50+ new contacts a week); occasional_checkout_emails = We collect some emails but rarely use them; no_database_social_only = Social media and walk-ins only; paid_ads_no_list = Paid ads, but no guest list of our own.

country.description: Where the restaurant is: a two-letter ISO 3166-1 code such as US, CA, AU or DE (GB for the United Kingdom). Sets the currency and local wording. Defaults to US.

deliveryDependency.description: How much of your sales come through DoorDash, Uber Eats or similar apps? zero_direct_only = None (Dine-in and our own ordering only); under_15_with_markup = Under 15% (With higher app prices to cover fees); 15_to_35_standard_cut = 15% – 35% (At regular menu prices); over_35_heavy_drag = More than 35%.

laborFlexing.description: When a shift gets slow, what happens to staffing? realtime_cuts_splh = We cut staff based on sales per labor hour; fixed_shifts_regardless = Everyone works their scheduled shift anyway; overtime_above_8_percent = Overtime is common (More than 8% of hours); chronic_understaffing_owner_covers = We're short-staffed (The owner or GM works the line).

monthlyRevenue.description: About how much do you sell in a typical month? Amounts are in US dollars, or in the local currency where that's the euro, pound sterling, Swiss franc, or Canadian, Australian or New Zealand dollar; restaurantdoctor_get_questions shows the exact ranges for a country. under_25k = Under $25,000 (Under $300K a year); 25k_60k = $25,000 – $60,000 ($300K – $720K a year); 60k_120k = $60,000 – $120,000 ($720K – $1.44M a year); over_120k = Over $120,000 (Over $1.44M a year).

occupancyCostRatio.description: What share of sales goes to rent, property costs and utilities? under_8_percent = Under 8%; 8_to_12_percent = 8% – 12%; over_12_percent = More than 12%; unsure_ratio = I'm not sure.

plateCostingFrequency.description: How often do you update recipe costs with current supplier prices? live_monthly_software = Monthly or live, with software (Synced to supplier invoices); 6_to_12m_manual = Once or twice a year (In a spreadsheet); new_menu_only = Only when the menu changes; rarely_gut_feeling = Rarely (Prices are set by feel or by competitors).

primeCostAwareness.description: What's your prime cost: food, drink and labor costs as a share of sales? under_58 = Under 58%; 58_to_64 = 58% – 64%; over_65 = 65% or more; not_tracked_weekly = I don't track it regularly.

reputationHealth.description: What's your average rating on Google and Yelp? 4_5_to_5_0 = 4.5 – 5.0 stars; 4_0_to_4_4 = 4.0 – 4.4 stars; 3_5_to_3_9 = 3.5 – 3.9 stars; under_3_5 = Below 3.5 stars.

seatingDynamics.description: How full is your dining room across the week? consistent_weekround = Steady all week; packed_weekends_dead_midweek = Packed on weekends, quiet midweek; strong_lunch_weak_dinner = Busy lunches, slow dinners; erratic_unpredictable = Hard to predict week to week.

serviceModel.description: What kind of restaurant do you run? quick_service = Quick service (Counter or kiosk, fast turnover); fast_casual = Fast casual (Order at the counter, food brought to the table); full_service = Full service / casual dining (Servers, moderate check); fine_dining = Fine dining (Chef-driven, higher check); bar_lounge = Bar, taproom or lounge (Drinks are about half of sales or more).

wasteTrackingMethod.description: How do you track kitchen waste and spoilage? daily_signed_log = A daily log the chef signs off; weekly_visual_estimate = A rough estimate during weekly inventory; bulk_loss_only = Only when a big batch or case goes bad; no_formal_logging = We don't track it.

anyOf.description: Why the overall grade differs from the area letters.

monthly.description: Its estimated money a month, as the website shows it big: lost for a leak, added sales for an opportunity.

biggest.description: The biggest leak, or the biggest sales opportunity when nothing leaks.

anyOf.description: With the owner's own numbers and a check-up.

prices.description: null when they couldn't be read.

fullReportAdds.description: What the paid full report adds.

link.description: Opens this result on the website.

yearlyLeak.description: null when no major leak was found.
